title: Sunburst Static
description: A jubilant dance-pop rush built on fat sawtooth chord stabs and a cracking AkaiLinn kit — the track hits full euphoria by the second minute, then playfully strips itself apart layer by layer into a glittering outro. Bright, driving, and unapologetically joyful.
